items.headline: Coastal Flood Statement issued September 29 at 2:56AM EDT until September 30 at 2:00PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, moderate coastal
flooding. For the Coastal Flood Statement, isolated minor
coastal flooding expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Palm Beach County, Coastal Broward County and
Coastal Miami Dade County.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 2 PM EDT this
afternoon. For the Coastal Flood Statement, from 2 PM EDT this
afternoon through Wednesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only isolated
road closures expected.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.
